channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: One marriage, two cuisines: Meet SF’s newest restaurant power couple
item.description: Laura and Sayat Ozyilmaz prove that working with your spouse isn’t a liability — it’s a strategy.

item.title: Stolen cash, nepotism, and a trunk full of jewelry: SF homeless nonprofit CEO charged
item.description: Gwendolyn Westbrook embezzled $91,000 and misappropriated more than $1.2 million from the United Council of Human Services, prosecutors say.

item.title: Kawakami: 49ers offseason predictions — Maxx Crosby, Eddy Piñeiro, Isaiah Likely, and more
item.description: Kyle Shanahan and John Lynch could turn one of the worst pass rushes in the league into one of the best with a trade for the Raiders star.

item.title: The Marina’s F1 fiasco: Peeing, roof-climbing, and a mayor along for the ride
item.description: San Francisco police made no arrests and called the event “extremely safe”

item.title: Rivers of melted cheese flood SF’s newest sandwich shop
item.description: Gada opened in the Castro last month and serves raclette sandwiches on Tunisian-style malawi bread.

item.title: CCA closure: Vanderbilt chancellor on the school’s big San Francisco takeover
item.description: Daniel Diermeier explains why Vanderbilt passed on the Chronicle Building, his interest in AI, and what will come of the city’s oldest arts school

item.title: Polymarket for restaurants: Let’s predict when SF’s most overhyped eateries will open
item.description: The race is on between Cliff House, Anchor Brewing, and Jollibee.

item.title: A sushi master and yakitori pro join forces near Union Square
item.description: TBD, from chefs Ray Lee and Tommy Cleary, opens in March after years in the making.

item.title: Michael Shvo ousted from Transamerica Pyramid after second sale of tower in 6 years
item.description: The current ownership group has been under scrutiny for lavish spending and big losses at one of San Francisco’s most recognizable properties.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: Which Warriors can keep this stretch run interesting?
item.description: As Steph Curry deals with a knee injury, Golden State is relying on less heralded players to execute coach Steve Kerr’s system.
